messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired - inference-high-latency (eu-west-1). Threshold: p95 latency > 500ms for 5m. Affected service: inference-router service-prod-eu.

pagerbot: Auto-escalation scheduled in 3m if not acknowledged. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-high-latency

Maya Kova: oncall here, acked. I'm looking at traces and LB metrics now.

Samir Patel: taking primary if you want to delegate Maya. I can dig into model pool saturation.

Maya Kova: TY. handing to @Samir. Primary -> Samir, secondary -> Maya. Noted customer impact: increased latency for hosted API; some customers seeing errors.

Samir Patel: quick snapshot: router CPU 85% on a subset of pods, batcher queue length spiked, redis KV cache miss rate up from 2% -> 18% in last 4m. Embedding requests show backlog on gpu-pool-eu-1.

Elena Sato: seeing a correlated spike in network egress between router and model-nodes (10Gbps -> 18Gbps), possibly retransmits. TLS handshakes count increased. Not sure if noisy neighbor from a batch job.

Carlos Mendez: rolling a quick command to drain a suspect k8s node with high network errors: `kubectl cordon node/gke-eu-3 && kubectl drain node/gke-eu-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will hold if this will impact capacity.

Samir Patel: hold on drain for 30s. I'm going to try a partial fallback: point a fraction of requests to smaller model variant to relieve GPU memory pressure. Patching route:

```yaml
- route: /v1/chat/completions
  policy:
    - condition: header.x-experimental-fallback == "true"
      model: redwood-small-v1
```

Samir Patel: rollout 10% traffic -> fallback. Applying now.

pagerbot: Fallback policy applied (10%): route update success.

Maya Kova: metrics: batcher queue dropped 40% after fallback, p95 latency down to ~420ms (was ~780ms). Redis miss rate still elevated.

Priya Rao: quick customer check: support queue saw 6 tickets in last 20m referencing "delay" and "timeout". No major enterprise SEPs yet. Notifying trust team FYI.

Elena Sato: I see a recent deploy to model-serving that changed kernel pins 22m ago (rev d4f3). Rollout shows 5% of pods got mixed kernel binding that can increase retransmits. Could be root cause.

Samir Patel: if kernel pinning mismatch is true, it's safer to route around affected pods. I'll add a nodeSelector exclusion for pods with that image tag. Running quick query to list pods: `kubectl get pods -n redwood -o wide --selector=app=model-serving --field-selector=status.phase=Running`

Carlos Mendez: listing shows 4 pods on gke-eu-3 with image rev d4f3. Proposal: cordon node then rollout restart model-serving daemonset to shift traffic. We should coordinate with private deployments? no impact there.

Maya Kova: agree. Do it in waves: cordon -> drain -> wait 2m -> uncordon, so we don't kill capacity. Carlos please proceed when Samir confirms.

Samir Patel: proceeding with cordon+drain on gke-eu-3 now.

pagerbot: action log: `kubectl cordon node/gke-eu-3` executed by Carlos Mendez.

Samir Patel: drain started. Observing model-serving scale-up on other nodes. Latency trending down further: p95 ~320ms.

Priya Rao: Customer impact update: impacted customers reduced from 12 -> 3 active tickets. No errors for high-tier accounts reported. Prioritizing any remaining tickets for proactive outreach.

Elena Sato: after cordon, network retransmits reduced and redis miss rate slowly descending. Looks like the noisy node had intermittent NIC faults. File a hardware ticket? (cc: infra)

Maya Kova: filing HW ticket and adding incident tag. Incident severity: Sev-2 -> current state degraded but mitigated with fallback.

Samir Patel: final mitigation: keep 10% fallback for 15m, let model-serving rollout finish and confirm redis miss rate < 5% and p95 < 300ms. If stable, we'll remove fallback.

Carlos Mendez: hardware ticket created: HW-7892 assigned to infra-netops. Node is quarantined.

Priya Rao: prepping post-incident comms: summary + customer list + timeline. Will draft and share in ~20m.

Maya Kova: health checks passing, no new pages for 12m. I'll start the postmortem doc and grab relevant traces. Thanks team.

incident-bot: Incident update: status changed to "mitigated" by Maya Kova. Next steps: postmortem + remediation (blacklist noisy node types, add NIC health alert).

Samir Patel: removing fallback now (rolling back routing change).

pagerbot: Route rollback applied. Verified traffic back to primary model variants.

Maya Kova: closing out: p95 stable ~210ms, redis miss ~1.8%, customer tickets down to 0. Marking incident resolved; will ping for postmortem review. :white_check_mark:
